note: Team notes for the pilot day, from the Zocus WhatsApp group, plus what Claude read from the recordings at each refresh. One entry per conversation, keyed by the conversation number. Fields: rep (nickname), customer, segment, model / models (as the customer saw them), fuel, colour, value (rupees, set by hand), remarks (shown on the conversation), prices (what was quoted: m = model or variant, p = rupees or text, b = basis, at = time in the recording), tr_en (English for key transcript lines, keyed by the line's time), csv (any CSV column to override, for example objection_quote_en), drop (true to leave the call out) with why.
